$meta.name: SoWetin design tokens
$meta.notes: Light theme only in V1. Every component reads tokens; no raw hex values in components. Text on color.palm must be color.ink (white on palm fails contrast). Prices use font.numeric. Map these to CSS variables (--sw-*) and Tailwind theme values.

palm.$description: Primary brand and primary buttons. Use ink text on it (6.3:1).

palm-600.$description: Pressed or hover state of palm.

palm-100.$description: Palm tint for selected chips and highlights.

enamel.$description: Enamel-plate blue. Links, info, plate rims, secondary emphasis. White text OK (6.6:1).

ugu.$description: Success, fresh prices, 'fits budget'. White text OK (5.5:1).

egusi.$description: Rewards, celebration accents, 'Haven't had this in a while'. Ink text only.

amber.$description: Warnings: 'A little over', 'Rough estimate'. Text on cream or white OK (4.7:1).

scotch.$description: Errors and allergy warnings. White text OK (5.8:1).

ink.$description: Primary text, outlines of interactive elements, hard shadows (pot black).

ink-3.$description: Tertiary text and placeholders (5.1:1 on cream).

focus.$description: Focus ring colour, 3 px with 2 px cream offset.

display.$value: 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Lufga', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Arial, sans-serif
display.$description: Headings only, weights 600 to 800. Self-host a Latin subset WOFF2. Use Lufga instead if Chopbaze's licence covers web (Q-07). Check the ₦ glyph; if missing, never set prices in this face.

body.$value: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
body.$description: Body text and labels (D-25). Self-host one variable WOFF2 subset, weights 400 to 800, Basic Latin + Latin-1 + ₦, 30 KB or less, with a size-adjusted fallback. Has the ₦ glyph and tabular figures.

numeric.$value: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Arial, sans-serif
numeric.$description: Prices and counters, with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Same file as body (D-25).

input.$description: 16 px minimum stops iOS zoom on focus

interactive.$description: Chunky outline on buttons, chips, cards that act like buttons

button.$description: Hard offset shadow; pressed state removes it and moves the button down 3 px

rule.$description: Never animate box-shadow. Animate transform and opacity only.
